title: CaptureIssue
description: A captured idea or fix, filed as a GitHub issue. Input to scripts/capture/validate-capture.py, which validates it and renders the fixed markdown issue body. A sealed capture is one made outside a known project or session context: it must carry no where or session, and its rendered body drops those two sections.

title.description: Issue title. Must contain at least one non-whitespace character.

label.description: Issue label. 'idea' for something to explore, 'fix' for something broken.

sealed.description: True when the capture must not carry where or session context. A sealed capture requires where and session to be empty or absent.

what.description: What is being captured. 1 to 3 lines (at most 2 newline characters).

why.description: Why it matters or what triggered the capture. Rendered under the 'Why / trigger' heading.

where.description: Where it applies (repo, file, URL). Must be empty or absent when sealed is true.

session.description: Session reference (id, transcript path, or branch). Must be empty or absent when sealed is true.
